edits.name: split
edits.description: `isEntityNameExpression` stops calling `isPropertyAccessEntityNameExpression` and inlines the test instead. The back edge is gone, so the two-member group becomes two singletons.
edits.replace: return node.kind === SyntaxKind.Identifier || (isPropertyAccessExpression(node) && isIdentifier(node.name) && node.expression.kind === SyntaxKind.Identifier);

edits.name: merge
edits.description: `isEntityNameExpression` gains a call to `isBindableStaticNameExpression`, which already reaches it. One added edge closes the path, so its group and the assignment-declaration group become one.
